title: Norwegian Names Now Spoken Right in Ukrainian Stories | vitalii.no
description:
Norwegian names spoken inside a Ukrainian story used to get transliterated into Cyrillic — a farm, a road, a lake name read like a Ukrainian guess at the spelling instead of the real word — even though the app already had a real Norwegian voice recording that same name correctly in its Norwegian-language version of the same story.

I changed the story-generation prompt so the AI now keeps Norwegian proper names in their original spelling, marked inside special brackets, instead of transliterating them into Cyrillic. The audio pipeline then splices in the actual Norwegian-voice recording of that name, at a matching timbre, wherever a marked name appears inside the Ukrainian audio — instead of making the Ukrainian voice attempt the pronunciation.

Because this changed the format of already-published stories, a new batch script rewrote the existing Cyrillic transliterations back into the marked Norwegian spelling eight stories at a time, keeping the original text as a backup in case anything needed to be reverted. The fix reached every story already published, not just new ones.
